title: Digital Asset Properties
description: Category-specific properties for digital assets: domains, social media, subscriptions, crypto wallets, cloud storage, NFTs, gaming accounts
$comment: This schema is composed with asset.json via allOf+if/then. Do NOT use additionalProperties:false here — it would reject core asset fields.

digitalAccess.description: Structured access information for digital assets — login credentials, 2FA, recovery methods, and platform death policies. Critical for executors managing the digital estate
digitalAccess.$comment: For digital category assets. Does NOT store passwords — stores references to where credentials are held.

username.description: Username or login identifier for this account

passwordStorageLocation.description: Where the password is stored — a password manager, physical location, or person who holds it
examples: Safe deposit box at Barclays Wrexham
Written in sealed envelope with solicitor

passwordManager.description: Name of the password manager holding credentials for this account

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether two-factor authentication is enabled on this account

recoveryMethods.description: Methods available to recover access to this account if the primary credentials are unavailable

type.$comment: backup_codes: pre-generated one-time codes. email: recovery via email address. phone: recovery via phone number. security_key: physical security key (YubiKey, etc.).

location.description: Where this recovery method or device is stored
examples: Backup codes in LastPass secure notes

platformDeathPolicy.description: The platform's policy for handling accounts after the holder's death
platformDeathPolicy.$comment: memorialise: account is converted to a memorial page (Facebook). delete: account is deleted on request. transfer: account ownership can be transferred. archive: account is archived and data can be downloaded. unknown: policy not known or not investigated.

legacyContactConfigured.description: Whether a legacy contact has been configured on the platform (e.g. Google Inactive Account Manager, Facebook Legacy Contact)

legacyContactPersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id configured as the platform's legacy contact

socialMedia.description: Social media account details for digital assets

transferToPersonId.description: Person.id to transfer the account to

cryptoAccess.description: Cryptocurrency wallet and key access information

privateKeyLocation.description: Where the private key is stored — DO NOT store the key itself

seedPhraseLocation.description: Where the seed phrase is stored — DO NOT store it

cloudStorage.description: Cloud storage account details for digital assets — provider, usage, important folders, family photo access

importantFolders.description: Important folders that need attention during estate administration

action.description: What should happen to this folder

familyPhotoAccess.description: Whether the account contains family photos that should be preserved and shared

domainNameAccess.description: Domain name registration details — registrar, expiry, transfer locks. Critical for executors managing digital estates with web properties
domainNameAccess.$comment: RDAP (Registration Data Access Protocol, RFC 9082/9083) replaced WHOIS. Domain transfers require an auth code — never store the code itself, only its location.

registrantOrganisationId.description: Organisation.id of the registrant, if the domain is held by an organisation

transferLocked.description: Whether the domain has a transfer lock (registrar lock / clientTransferProhibited)

authCodeLocation.description: Where the transfer auth code is stored — reference only, never the code itself

nameservers.description: Nameservers currently assigned to the domain

nftAccess.description: Non-fungible token (NFT) details — blockchain, contract, token identifier, and marketplace information
nftAccess.$comment: ERC-721 (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-721) and ERC-1155 (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1155) are the dominant NFT standards. tokenId is a string because ERC-1155 token IDs can exceed JavaScript's Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER.

blockchain.description: The blockchain network hosting the NFT

contractAddress.description: Smart contract address for the NFT collection

tokenId.description: Token identifier — string because can be very large integers

tokenStandard.description: The token standard used by the NFT contract

marketplace.description: Primary marketplace where this NFT is listed or was purchased

marketplaceUrl.description: Direct URL to the NFT listing on the marketplace

monetisedContentAccess.description: Monetised online content — YouTube channels, Substack newsletters, Patreon pages, and similar revenue-generating content platforms
monetisedContentAccess.$comment: Revenue and subscriber data helps executors understand the ongoing financial value of digital content assets.

channelUrl.description: Direct URL to the channel or storefront

channelName.description: Display name of the channel or storefront

subscriberCount.description: Number of subscribers or followers on the platform

monthlyRevenue.description: Approximate monthly revenue from the platform, in minor currency units

monetisationStatus.description: Current monetisation status of the content
monetisationStatus.$comment: active: currently earning revenue. suspended: temporarily suspended by the platform. demonetised: monetisation removed by the platform. pending: applied for monetisation, awaiting approval. none: not monetised.

loyaltyAccess.description: Loyalty programme points and rewards — airline miles, hotel points, retailer schemes. Some programmes permit post-death transfer; others forfeit on death
loyaltyAccess.$comment: Transferability varies by programme. Avios, for example, can be transferred to a named beneficiary. Many hotel and retail programmes forfeit points on death — check terms.

cashEquivalent.description: Approximate cash equivalent of the points balance, in minor currency units

expiryDate.description: Date when the points expire if not used

transferable.description: Whether the programme permits transfer of points after death

transferUrl.description: URL to the programme's transfer or bereavement page

gamingAccess.description: Gaming platform account details — Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and similar platforms with virtual currencies and digital game libraries
gamingAccess.$comment: Most gaming platforms do not permit account transfer after death — the account and its library are typically non-transferable per terms of service. Virtual currency balances may have real-world value.

accountName.description: Account name or gamertag on the platform

virtualCurrencyBalance.description: Balance of virtual currency on the platform

transferable.description: Whether the platform permits account or library transfer after death

estimatedRealValue.description: Estimated real-world value of the account's digital assets, in minor currency units

platformDelegation.description: Instructions for what should happen to a digital asset or account after death — memorialise, delete, transfer, archive, or preserve
platformDelegation.$comment: Complements digitalAccess.platformDeathPolicy (what the platform offers) with the testator's actual wishes. delayDuration uses ISO 8601 duration format.

action.description: Desired post-death action for this digital asset
action.$comment: memorialise: convert to a memorial page. delete: permanently delete the account and its content. transfer: transfer ownership to another person. archive: download and archive all data, then close. deactivate: disable the account without deleting data. preserve: keep the account active and unchanged indefinitely.

delayDuration.description: How long to wait before executing the action, as an ISO 8601 duration

transferToPersonId.description: Person.id to transfer the asset to (when action is 'transfer')

specificInstructions.description: Free-text instructions for the executor regarding this digital asset

platformToolConfigured.description: Whether the platform's native death/inactivity tool has been set up

platformToolType.description: Which platform tool has been configured, if any
platformToolType.$comment: inactive_account_manager: Google Inactive Account Manager. legacy_contact: Facebook/Apple Legacy Contact. digital_legacy: Apple Digital Legacy. memorialisation_request: Facebook memorialisation. none: no tool configured. other: a platform-specific tool not listed.

configuredDate.description: Date when the platform tool was configured

fiduciaryAccess.description: How a fiduciary (executor, personal representative) can gain lawful access to this digital asset after death
fiduciaryAccess.$comment: RUFADAA (Revised Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act) is the US model law governing fiduciary access to digital assets. It distinguishes between 'catalogue' access (metadata: sender, recipient, date) and 'content' access (message bodies, files). Many US states have enacted RUFADAA or similar legislation. See https://www.uniformlaws.org/committees/community-home?CommunityKey=f7237fc4-74c2-4728-81c6-b39a91ecdf22

accessMethod.description: The method by which a fiduciary can access this digital asset
accessMethod.$comment: designated_recipient: named in an online tool (Google IAM, Apple Digital Legacy). legacy_contact: platform-specific legacy contact. inactive_account_manager: Google-specific inactivity tool. court_order: requires a court order. rufadaa_request: request under RUFADAA or equivalent statute. platform_form: submit a bereavement form to the platform. credential_sharing: credentials shared directly (least preferred). none: no access method available or configured.

accessConfigured.description: Whether the chosen access method has been set up with the platform

designatedRecipientPersonId.description: Person.id of the designated recipient for this digital asset

accessScope.$comment: catalogue_only: metadata only (sender, recipient, date, subject). full_content: complete access to message bodies and files. restricted: platform-specific restrictions apply. unknown: scope not determined.

termsOfServiceUrl.description: URL to the platform's terms of service or bereavement policy

termsOfServiceConstraints.description: Summary of key constraints from the platform's terms of service that affect fiduciary access
